note: _formatPmDate (src/scrapers/relay.js) reads a month-only due ('Nov 2026', AAP dueDateDisplayFormat MONTH_AND_YEAR) as the 1st of the month. AAP's own nextDueDate for MONTH_AND_YEAR items is the last day of the month (pmSchedule on the live rows: 'Dec 2026' -> nextDueIso 2026-12-31, 'Jan 2027' -> 2027-01-31, 'Oct 2026' -> 2026-10-31). So four Active AUVTE units show an 'overdue' pill for an item that is due by 11/30 (Quarterly Lift on B12029, B12257, B12259; PM X on B62020), and B12195 shows its Lift pill as 'Dec 1' while AAP says due by 2026-12-31. The Oct 2026 Lift pills on B13014 and B62064 are correctly overdue (16 days).
assistantRule: Until the pill is fixed, the assistant reads month-only dues as end of month and never reports a 'Nov 2026' item as overdue before 2026-12-01.
